next_step: Deliver scoped POC plan + cost model; arrange sandbox access for Zendesk test tenant
notes:
Overview:
- Lodestar Envelope AI provides a shared inbox + ticketing layer for mid-market e-commerce merchants (30k monthly tickets across customers).
- Primary ask: reliable ticket/email summarization + automatic tagging to drive macros/workflow routing in Zendesk/Freshdesk.

Discovery summary (call 2026-02-11):
- Met with Head of Support (Alyssa Moore) + Engineering lead (Diego Ramos).
- They want: one-sentence summary + 3 bullet context, confidence score, suggested tags (product_area, urgency, language, intent), and suggested macro id.
- Typical ticket length: 1-5 messages; but spike case: 2k concurrent requests during sales events.
- SLA target: P95 generation latency < 400ms for summaries on Dedicated; < 700ms acceptable for hosted during spikes.
- Throughput target: baseline 50 req/s, burst to 600 req/s for 10-20 minutes.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high — prefer fewer tokens per call and batched inference; looking to minimize per-ticket cost without losing accuracy on tag recall.

Integration & workflows:
- Primary production integration will be Zendesk (macros + triggers) + Freshdesk for select customers.
- Needs: webhook that returns: summary, tags, macro_id, update_fields. Must support idempotency and backpressure.
- Want optional tool-calling for live agent: lookup of order status (internal API) and include order snippet in summary.
- Desire to run canary for 2 weeks on 5% of tickets, compare macro acceptance rate and time-to-first-response delta.

Security / compliance notes:
- Must support SSO (Okta) for Redwood Console access and audit logs retained 12 months.
- Data residency: EU customer roster requires EU-hosted inference for those tenants; Lodestar wants region-aware routing.
- KMS for keys, and retention controls (30/90/365 configurable).
- Will require SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence and a short security questionnaire (sent).

POC scope proposal (Riley):
- Week 0: Share sample dataset mapping (10k anonymized tickets) + define label set for tags.
- Week 1: Hosted API POC with streaming summaries on Redwood sandbox, 1k tickets processed; compare against current heuristic summaries.
- Week 2: Integrate Zendesk sandbox via webhook; implement macro mapping and run small canary.
- Week 3: Load test to simulate burst (600 req/s) and evaluate latency/cost; present findings.

Key quotes / call snippets:
- Alyssa: "If we can cut average handle time by 15% while keeping tag precision >85% we'll move to paid."
- Diego: "We need deterministic fallbacks if the model returns low confidence — map to 'manual review' and attach ticket to specialists queue."

Technical requirements (short):
- Model preference: open models allowed; prefer quantized variant with Redwood-verified perf profile.
- Routing: policy to route EU-subtenant traffic to EU region, fallback to lower-capacity cheaper model if top-tier is unavailable.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-request latency, confidence histograms, and per-tag precision tracking.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2026-01-28: Lead created via webinar sign-up.
- 2026-02-04: Intro call (Jordan + Alyssa); high-level fit.
- 2026-02-11: Deep-dive with engineering (fireflies id ff_20260211_6f3b2a).
- 2026-02-18: Sent security questionnaire + sample dataset request (drive link).
- 2026-03-02: Received anonymized ticket export (10k) for POC.
- 2026-03-08: Ops sync; confirmed Zendesk sandbox credentials pending.

Success metrics for POC:
- Tag precision >= 85% and recall >= 80% on critical tag set (order_issue, refund, shipping_delay).
- Average summary helpfulness score (agent survey) >= 4/5.
- End-to-end webhook median latency < 350ms under baseline load.

Next steps (short):
- Jordan: send POC contract + infra checklist.
- Riley: produce cost model options (hosted vs dedicated) and required quotas.
- Lodestar: provision Zendesk sandbox credentials and confirm EU tenant list.

Open blockers / risks:
- Legal needs data processing addendum signed before accessing full dataset.
- Engineering bandwidth to wire tool-calls (order lookup) into Redwood POC.
- Cost sensitivity may push them to adopt smaller quantized models, need to validate quality loss.

Internal notes for AE/SE:
- Emphasize Redwood Optimize for batching/caching suggestions — big cost lever for their bursty traffic.
- Prepare canary playbook (rollout %, rollback triggers).
- Suggest integrating confidence-based fallback to manual-review queue as default.
brief_description: Mid-market SaaS (support layer) evaluating Redwood for ticket/email summarization + auto-tagging in Zendesk/Freshdesk; POC requested focusing on latency under burst, tag precision, and webhook/macro integration.
